parsed.post: Discarding the jump to 0.9903. It's a clean re-baseline on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9', confirming that our prior best (0.8359) was heavily contaminated by shard 10. Reverting to my previous contaminated best as a placeholder to try one last clean optimization: lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.02 on the clean shards.
parsed.description: Testing a lower learning rate (0.02) on clean shards (0-9) to see if further convergence is possible without the leakage-induced inflation.
